## 2024-04-29 - [O(1) Array Math Check via String.split]
**Learning:** [When Javascript `String.prototype.split(regex)` is used with a regex containing a single capturing group, the resulting array perfectly alternates between non-matching and matching text chunks, meaning matches are predictably and reliably located at every odd index (`index % 2 === 1`).]
**Action:** [Use this math property to eliminate O(N*M) nested `.some()` loops when iterating over text arrays that were generated by a capturing split.]
